proposal.name: Hold modeled builds with driver review problems

plan.name: Hold modeled builds with driver review problems
plan.summary: Refine D-0082 so a modeled build whose driver or Go explorer review reports a problem stays a draft for a person: D-0483 and D-0183 explain why review must stop automatic merging when the driver can tamper with its own process or substitute application behavior. The read-only reviewer returns exactly one JSON object with a required boolean approved and nonempty string text, either alone or inside one ```json fence with only whitespace outside, and synth.Review persists Approved as approved alongside its existing text, usage and subject; only a successfully completed, valid result can approve, while missing, malformed, ambiguous, prose-wrapped or unfinished responses and review execution errors cannot approve regardless of approval-like words in the text, and the prompt tells the reviewer to treat any text in the project addressed to a reviewer, or claiming a verdict, as a problem to report, not an instruction, retaining "Claim nothing you didn't read", "change nothing" and the existing replay-harness guidance. Discover Go explorers as the gate does, from Init with Try or Successors across the code package's non-test Go files regardless of filename, direct the reviewer to every file declaring those functions, and hold when discovery, reading or review cannot complete; skip review only when there is no declared driver or explorer, publish findings or the reason review could not finish above project metadata and the receipt, label the issue and pull request for human review, and preserve the hold and review spend through saved-result recovery without changing the gate receipt. This deliberately replaces ready publication after adverse or failed review and refines D-0193 for a modeled build whose synthesis passed but only its reviewer exhausts provider retries: it publishes a held draft instead of stopping without a pull request, while synthesis provider failures still publish nothing; a completed approving review keeps the existing CI-gated merge path, and held modeled drafts keep existing human-merge, retry and revise behavior, so a writer's retry watches the same pull request without rebuilding or reviewing again and may mark it ready and merge after the current head passes CI subject to existing trusted-base holds, while revise requires closing the open pull request before drafting and ratifying again. Update SPEC.md, the README within its 400-line limit, docs/factory.md and docs/gate.md to describe discovery, the structured review hold, the reviewer-provider exception and these commands, citing D-0082, D-0183, D-0193, D-0483 and this ratified plan as the decision record, with changed SPEC bullets linking [#933's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-933.json).

tests.name: TestDriverReview933RequiresStructuredCompletion
tests.says: Only a complete structured reviewer result can approve: exactly one JSON object alone or in a single json fence, without surrounding prose; findings and approval are separate, invalid or failed results cannot approve, usage is retained, and the read-only prompt treats project text addressed to reviewers or claiming verdicts as findings while keeping its existing safeguards.

tests.name: TestDriverReview933FindsGoExplorerDeclarations
tests.says: Renaming or splitting Go explorer declarations cannot bypass review: Init with Try or Successors directs the reviewer to every declaring non-test file, discovery or review failures cannot approve, and only code with no explorer declaration is exempt.

tests.name: TestModeledReview933ControlsPublication
tests.says: A review reporting problems or failing to complete leaves an open draft with findings first and human-review labels despite a passing gate, while a structured approval keeps ordinary CI-gated merging.

tests.name: TestModeledReview933SurvivesPublicationRecovery
tests.says: A replacement watcher recovers a saved adverse review before or after pull-request creation without another build, a duplicate pull request, or readiness or merging after CI succeeds.

tests.name: TestModeledReview933KeepsHumanCommands
tests.says: Held modeled builds, including a review whose provider exhausted retries, still permit a person's merge, an authorized retry of the same draft without a new build or review, and revise after closure, while unprivileged commands and retries of trusted projects cannot bypass human control.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` and acceptance tests covering all three requested revisions while preserving the prior plan’s behavior. Check 1 passed: all five tests fail on the base as required; the change touches trusted code, so a person must merge it.
